title: "sub toaster" distortion rack demo
text:
demo of a bitwig rack i made that lets us use clipping / bitcrush / distortion with a bit more nuance and control. tldr:
- clip elements/textures against the bass
- keep the clean sub in parallel

obviously this is all to taste, depending on what you're making the dry sound or fully distorted sound might be ideal with some additional mastering and problem solving

more info: https://sump.substack.com/p/sub-toaster

similar trick within a single third-party plugin: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D4YLFTE_5co

title: Ursula LeGuin, Initiation Song from the Finders' Lodge
text:
Please bring strange things.
Please come bringing new things.
Let very old things come into your hands.
Let what you do not know come into your eyes.
Let desert sand harden your feet.
Let the arch of your feet be the mountains.
Let the paths of your fingertips be your maps
and the ways you go be the lines on your palms.
Let there be deep snow in your inbreathing
and your outbreath be the shining of ice.
May your mouth contain the shapes of strange words.
May you smell food cooking you have not eaten.
May the spring of a foreign river be your navel.
May your soul be at home where there are no houses.
Walk carefully, well loved one,
walk mindfully, well loved one,
walk fearlessly, well loved one.
Return with us, return to us,
be always coming home.
